decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot is a core element of the firm's automation strategy, and with only two years on the market its value in long investment cycles for precast plants is still uncertain while keeping it listed costs little.

The automatic de-shuttering robot shares engineering with the other circulation robots, so keeping this modular option open is cheap while customer adoption of automated plants is still being revealed.
The automatic shuttering robot fits the push toward automated precast production, and with no evidence yet that its value will not materialize, abandoning it would forfeit upside at little saving.
The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine line was launched only in 2024 with several models, so its uncertainty is high and the option should stay open until results come in.
The production analysis software is cheap to maintain, complements the equipment and lifecycle offer, and is too new for its value to be judged, so keeping it preserves the option.
